sources.limitations: Not clinical approval or a universal ordinary-training restriction.

protocol.execution: Supine/standing static abduction; bridges, squats, sidesteps; later offset variants and band sideslides.
protocol.dose: Week 1 supine static abduction 3–5 repetitions of 5–10-second holds; one set; light effort.
protocol.frequency: Static abduction twice daily; 8-week staged program.
protocol.supervision: 14 supervised sessions/8 weeks plus home work.
protocol.progression: Functional work Borg 13–15; heavy work 14–17 as tolerated.
protocol.stoppingRules: No pain increase functional retraining; heavy slow work ≤ 5/10 only if settles and no worse that night/next morning.

exerciseMappings.matchRationale: Existing dynamic abduction entries do not verify static supine execution; preserve missing setup rather than invent a band or angle.
Figure 1 shows a supine bridge with bent knees and staggered supported feet; catalog single-leg bridge lifts a foot. No numeric angle, precise loading distribution or clinical clearance inferred.

gaps: All material is draft and clinically unreviewed; no runtime mapping, supported-condition claim, default dose or escalation clearance follows.
No universal numeric load/range cap or hard exercise contraindication was established; benefit from alternatives and trial exclusions do not prove harm.
Concurrent condition restrictions, equipment requirements and independent joint limits remain controlling; stretching never earns strength-set credit or generic five-second progression.
Trial package does not isolate compression avoidance or any exercise; avoid treating all adduction or side-lying as permanently contraindicated.
Offset bridge Figure 1 visually inspected; static abduction setup and other figures still require verification. Clinical and exact catalog-match review remain open.
